client_brief:
Northgrove: colourway image set

Project overview
Northgrove is the repeat client for this benchmark series. We are hiring an expert to turn the supplied working files into Northgrove colourway image set, six styles at one look and Site plates and transparent feed files.

What we will provide
northgrove_styles/ (6 garment frames, 4200px long edge); northgrove_mark.png; northgrove_placements.txt; northgrove_copy.txt. Every file must be accounted for in the final manifest; it may be used, retained as reference, superseded, or rejected with a reason.

Additional archive files
northgrove_colourcard.pdf; northgrove_colourways.csv. These files are supplied for provenance only because their former deliverable class is outside this commission. Do not silently turn them into extra scope.

Scope and deliverables
- Northgrove colourway image set, six styles at one look: Six styles from two halves of a shoot brought to one studio look, and the seven colourways built out of the cloth on the carrier styles so that weave, fold shadow and seam shading survive the move, delivered at the product page and feed crops composed for...
- Site plates and transparent feed files: Each delivered style as a plate on the site's off white ground and as a transparent file at the marketplace feed's stated pixel dimensions, with genuine partial alpha at the edges and an edge that holds on the off white and on the club navy, judged on...

Non-negotiables
- Do not invent names, prices, claims, product features, locations, credentials, records, or documentary events that are absent from the approved inputs.
- Do not silently replace a weak supplied asset. Use it honestly, reject it with a reason, or take only the brief's declared Stock or concept exception.
- Preserve identity, product geometry, material behavior, and documentary truth; retouching may improve presentation but may not change what the subject is.
- Color variants are approval concepts until physical samples are photographed and signed off.

Working process
Please begin with an inventory and risk pass, submit the first proof or direction at the stated checkpoint, then revise against consolidated feedback. We are hiring for judgment: flag contradictions early, make the strongest defensible choice, and document any source limitation rather than hiding it.

Contract
$900-$2,400 fixed; target delivery 7 to 15 business days; one technical proof and two consolidated revision rounds. Final handoff includes the delivery manifest, editable sources where scoped, final exports, and a concise production note.

source_provenance.statement: The scenario is synthesized from the repository's laundered Upwork and Freelancer source anchors. It is not represented as a verbatim live listing.
source_provenance.original_anchor: Ledger anchor for PHOTO-10, three Freelancer.com and Upwork briefs reconciled into one commission. The first grounding_note, quoted as far as the ledger carries it: 'Adapted from a real Freelancer.com background-removal/apparel brief (client wanted an amateur worn-shirt shot cleaned up and a similar shirt isolated for a listing). The literal asks in that brief, compositing a second shirt into the scene and AI-erasing room clutter, are both on the connector's NOT-AVAILABLE list, so the job is honestly re-cast to the in-scope apparel-catalog intent the bg_removal_batch category points at, and SCALED UP to a real capsule-line workload instead of a single hero. The fictional brand NORTHGROVE (olive leaf glyph + charcoal condensed-sans wordmark) is invented'. The second: 'Adapted from a real Freelancer.com flat-lay apparel brief (a marketplace seller wanting a clean, consistent set of flat-lay photos shot directly overhead, evenly lit, on a mid-gray backdrop that keeps dark and light fabrics balanced on screen, plus high-resolution JPEGs plus web-ready versions)'. The third anchor absorbs AO-63, an Upwork club identity brief built around street cricket and a South Asian diaspora league; per the Western frame requirement that is converted here to a local amateur football club supporters' crew, and no real club, league, label or person is named. Absorbs AO-39, AO-113 and AO-63. The rebuild is needed because the ledger concept sat entirely on one imaging surface and its collateral list was five variants of one picture, which is one deliverable rather than five. The fuller commission a capsule brand actually buys at this scale is the one written here: the six frames brought to one shoot, the colourways built out of the cloth rather than laid over it, the cut outs that have to survive both an off white product page and a deep club navy, the mill's colour approval cards run as a genuine record per page merge from the card the mill already uses, the mark recovered from the only artefact that still carries it, and the launch canvases the brand edits itself. Northgrove and Rowanfield Athletic are invented; no real brand, mill, marketplace or club is referenced.

price_band_and_audience: Elevated basics at 32 to 60 dollars, bought online by women and men aged 22 to 38 who are choosing on a phone and comparing against both a 9 dollar fast fashion tee and a 140 dollar heritage one. The band is load-bearing on almost every decision in the job. At 9 dollars an obvious flat tint over a garment shape is tolerated because nobody expects the picture to be the product. At 32 to 60 the whole proposition is that the cloth is better than it looks in the price, so a colourway that reads as a filter destroys the one thing the brand is selling and drives a return that costs more than the margin. It also sets the treatment: soft daylight, visible weave, real fold shadow, a neutral ground, no glossy retouch and no fashion editorial grade. A luxury treatment (deep contrast, cool shadow, hard rim light) misprices the capsule upward and reads as dishonest when the parcel arrives; a marketplace treatment (blown white, crushed shadow, oversaturated colour) misprices it downward. The mill cards are a trade document read by a dye house and by wholesale buyers, so they are plain, accurate and unstyled. The ledger records the base concept at 350 to 800 dollars; this fuller commission, with the merge run and the editable canvases, runs 1,200 to 2,400 dollars fixed.

assets_supplied.name: northgrove_styles/ (6 garment frames, 4200px long edge)
assets_supplied.visible_description: "One frame per style, laid flat and pinned on our warm grey seamless, shot overhead. Three on the bright morning, three after the weather turned." Each style photographed in the single colour it was physically made in.
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: Two things the client cannot see. First, the oatmeal marl crew sits at almost the same value as the warm grey paper it was shot on, so a knockout on that style either bites into the shoulder seam and the ribbed cuff or leaves a soft pale rim of captured paper around them, and both look perfectly clean on white and on the site's off white. Second, the two halves of the shoot did not just shift in warmth: the paper and the cloth moved by different amounts, so the base garment hue itself differs between the halves, and one recolour parameter set cannot carry a colourway across both halves even after the frames have been brought to one look.

assets_supplied.name: northgrove_colourcard.pdf
assets_supplied.visible_description: "The colour approval card the mill has always used, one card per page, as a press PDF from the studio that used to make them for us." A real font embedding press PDF with a swatch window, a header block and a specification block.
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: The card's specification block is set as one continuous flow on the page, so what the converted document exposes as separately mappable frames bears no relation to the visual blocks the printed card shows, and the mapping readout drops one run out of the middle of that story while keeping its line break, so the string still reads as well formed and every offset past it is short by exactly that run's length. The validator returns valid on the wrong offsets and the placeholder step reports completed successfully, and the omission only becomes visible on a merged card.

assets_supplied.name: northgrove_mark.png
assets_supplied.visible_description: "Our leaf glyph and our wordmark. This 900px PNG lifted off an old lookbook page is the only version anyone still has." Olive leaf glyph beside a charcoal condensed sans wordmark on a cream ground.
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: The glyph and the wordmark are two disjoint marks in one picture and the wordmark's letterforms carry enclosed counters, so the obvious knockout route returns a solid plate with the counters filled and keeps only the two or three letters that form the largest blob. Nothing in the response says so, and the failure is invisible until the mark is placed on the club navy, which is the one ground the brand actually needs it reversed on.

assets_supplied.name: northgrove_colourways.csv
assets_supplied.visible_description: Seven colourways with the mill's names, colour codes, fabric composition, dye lot references and the carrier style each one is approved against, plus a column for the swatch image.

assets_supplied.name: northgrove_placements.txt
assets_supplied.visible_description: The product page file sizes, the marketplace feed's transparency and pixel requirements, the site's off white and the club navy the lookbook header sits on, described in plain language.

assets_supplied.name: northgrove_copy.txt
assets_supplied.visible_description: Colourway story copy, the size run, the fabric and care lines, and the launch wording for the lookbook, the tall post and the square.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: How this particular cloth behaves when a colourway is dialled into it. The base garment's mid tones, its fold shadows and its seam shading do not carry the same hue as each other, so one masked move that makes a colourway look convincingly dyed in the flat of the chest can push the fold shadows somewhere else entirely, and the tile still looks completely plausible on its own. Compounding it, the two halves of the shoot left the base hue itself different between styles even after the frames were brought to one look, so a parameter set tuned on one carrier style lands somewhere else on the other. Nothing reports any of this. The adjustment succeeds, the file comes back, and the divergence only exists across the family and across the style pair.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: (a) Ordering cannot dodge it and care cannot pre empt it, because the behaviour is a property of this weave, this dye and this light, and there is no readout of any kind for colour in this toolset. (b) Nothing states it. The brief says the colourways must look dyed rather than filtered, which is the client naming her standing requirement exactly as she would to a designer, and the spreadsheet lists colourway names, not how far each one sits from the cloth she actually made. (c) It is not a propagation re run: the response is a different class of move (a desaturate and darken instead of a hue rotation, or a separate selection for the fold shadows so they can be moved on their own terms), a separate parameter set per carrier style, and possibly a written declaration that one colourway cannot be produced faithfully from this cloth, which changes what the mill card run carries.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Re dial the affected colourways on a different kind of move rather than pushing the same one harder, split the fabric mask where the fold shadows need their own treatment, run a separate parameter set for the second carrier style, and lay the family out again rather than assuming the second attempt took. If a colourway still will not come out of this cloth, decide what to do instead, say so in writing, and reconcile the merge run and the launch canvases against that decision.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: A capsule brand ships a product page where the deep colourways look like a coloured film over a photograph of a jumper, the exact thing its 32 to 60 dollar positioning cannot survive, and pays return shipping on every order where the parcel does not match the tile.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Whether the transparent feed files actually hold on the grounds they get used on. The oatmeal marl crew sits at almost the same value as the warm grey paper it was shot on, and the knockout resolves that either by cutting hard into the shoulder seam and the ribbed cuff or by leaving a soft rim of captured paper around them. Which of the two a given style gets is a property of that frame's light and that garment's own value, not of the route chosen or the care taken, and both are completely invisible on white and on the site's own off white. The operation reports success in both cases and the returned file looks correct at normal viewing size, which is why nobody catches it until the file is sitting on a marketplace listing or on the club navy in the lookbook header.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: (a) Ordering cannot avoid it. The transparent version has to be made regardless of order, no metadata reports edge quality, selection masks come back with no intermediate values at all so there is no feather to inspect, and the defect only exists relative to the ground the file is composited on. (b) Nothing states it. The brief names the three grounds the pictures have to survive, which is the client describing where her files go, not a statement that any style will fail on any of them, and no asset note names a style. (c) It is not a propagation re run. The fix is a different operation on a different principle, naming the paper and inverting rather than asking for the garment, plus a decision about whether a style whose cuff will not cut cleanly carries the feed placement at all.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Re cut the affected styles by naming the ground material and inverting rather than by asking for the garment, re composite on both grounds and inspect the cuff and shoulder again rather than assuming the second route worked, and inspect the styles that were not flagged at the same closeness, since the reason to look was found on one style and the rest have not been established as clean. If a style will not cut cleanly at all, move its feed placement to the plate route and say so.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: The marketplace listing that drives half the season's volume carries a garment with a pale halo traced round its cuffs, and the lookbook header on club navy shows the same halo at banner size in front of the club's own supporters.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: What the mill's card actually became when it was converted, and whether the fields landed. The card's specification block is one continuous flow on the printed page, so the converted document's frame granularity bears no relation to the visual blocks anyone can see on the card, and the readout the mapping tool returns for that frame silently drops one run out of the middle of the story while keeping its line break, so the string still reads as well formed and every offset past the omission is short by exactly that run's length. The validator returns valid with zero warnings on those offsets, the placeholder step reports completed successfully, and the merge then produces cards that are missing two fields entirely while looking like finished cards.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: (a) Ordering cannot avoid it and care cannot pre empt it, because both the frame granularity and the dropped run are properties of this specific PDF and are only discoverable by converting it and reading the document's own story back out. (b) Nothing states it. The brief says the mill wants its own card and hands over the PDF, which is the client supplying a template, not a disclosure about its internal structure, and no asset note or earlier step names a frame or a field. (c) It is not a propagation re run. The response is to recompute every offset from the document's true story text, restructure the mapping around the frames that actually exist rather than the blocks the card appears to show, re prepare the template and verify placeholder presence independently, which is a different method rather than the same call on changed input.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Round trip the prepared template and read its story back out rather than trusting either the readout or the success message, recompute all offsets from the reconstructed string, rebuild the mapping against the real frame inventory, re prepare, and confirm each expected placeholder is present before merging again. Then re merge and read an actual card, because a template that validates is not a card that carries its fields.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: A dye house receives fourteen colour approval cards with the fabric composition and the dye lot reference missing, approves lots against cards that do not identify them, and the capsule is cut in the wrong shade of one colourway before anyone notices.

decision_gates: Which of the six styles carries which placement, given how each garment's own value sits against the paper it was shot on.
How far each half of the shoot is pushed to reach one look, and where a correction stops being a correction and becomes a preset signature.
Whether to word a selection at the garment or at the cloth, knowing the two return completely different masks and only one of them can carry a recolour.
Which class of move each colourway needs, and whether the fold shadows need a mask of their own rather than riding along with the fabric field.
Whether a colourway that will not come out of this cloth is pushed harder, produced a different way, or declared unproducible in writing.
Knockout route per style rather than per set, and on which ground the edges are judged, given that both failure modes are invisible on white.
Whether a style whose cuff will not cut cleanly still carries the marketplace feed placement, and what carries it instead.
Whether to extend a frame at its edges or accept a tighter crop, knowing extended material has to match the brand's own ground.

acceptance_snapshot: Each colourway is recognisably the same colour across both carrier styles, judged across the pair rather than one style at a time.

Every colourway tile reads as cloth that was dyed that colour: the weave, the fold shadows and the seam shading are still doing their own work, and nothing reads as a flat colour laid over a garment shape.
The six styles read as one shoot, not as a bright morning and a grey afternoon, when laid out together.
The transparent versions hold their edge on the marketplace's off white and on the club navy, with no pale rim and no bitten seam or cuff, judged on those grounds and not on white.
The swatch window on each card carries that record's own swatch tile, not one static image repeated down the run.
Every supplied asset is listed in the delivery manifest as used, reference-only, superseded, or rejected with a concrete reason; no input disappears silently.
Final files open successfully, use unambiguous names, match the stated dimensions and formats, and include editable sources only where the scoped deliverable requires them.

why_not_vlm: Paste the brief and the assets into a frontier image model and it returns pictures of garments that are not these garments. IDENTITY is the commission: these are six specific pieces the brand has actually cut and will actually ship, and a customer who receives a different fit, a different rib or a different weave than the tile promised returns it. A regenerated colourway is a guess about a dye lot the mill is about to run. SPEC: the marketplace feed wants genuine transparency at stated pixel dimensions, the product page wants crops composed at the sizes they are used at, the mill wants exactly one card per row of its own spreadsheet with that row's fabric, code and dye lot on it and that row's swatch in the window, and nothing may exceed its source resolution. A generated image satisfies none of that and a generated card is a fabricated trade document. EDITABILITY: one deliverable is defined by being editable, three canvases in one document the brand changes every season, with live text and real vector geometry. And the middle of the job is verification against material reality: does this cloth take this colourway, does this cuff cut cleanly on the ground it will sit on, did these fields actually land on the merged card. None of that is a generation problem.

proof: Every required operation is present in the captured 99-tool ChatGPT Adobe inventory.

Artifact acceptance never depends on a raw connector response field.
Unsupported truth, fabrication, press, legal, or color claims have an explicit defer or disclose state.
residual_limits: Express work is template adaptation, not unrestricted canvas authoring.
Quick Cut is used only for visually led selection and never as semantic speech editing.
Automatic vectorization does not independently establish fabrication readiness.
Interactive Acrobat page-organization operations are excluded from zero-human execution.
